title: Grateful Dead Live at The Palestra, U. of Rochester on 1971-10-26
lineage: Source 1:  (all material on discs 1 & 2)SBD>MR>R>C>D>CD(pre FM) Source 2:  (all material on disc 3)SBD>MR>?>D>CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source riddled with wobble, pitch errors and dropouts, yet it delivers a solid 1971 performance highlighted by a fiery The Other One.
ai_review.review: The show is generally regarded as an enjoyable early‑Keith era set with strong moments like The Other One, One More Saturday Night and Jack Straw. However the SBD suffers from wow‑and‑flutter, speed/pitch inconsistencies and noticeable dropouts that keep it from being a clean listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars for the musical performance, but many note serious recording flaws; weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Wobble and pitch errors throughout, wow‑and‑flutter, several dropouts (including in Beat on Down the Line), buzzing and speed inconsistencies; overall listenable but far from pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set show (≈2 hr first set, ≈1 hr second) with a strong second half; some cuts in the official release but overall pacing is solid.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for energetic guitar work – pedal‑steel cameo, abundant fills and solos (especially on The Other One and El Paso).
band_member_comments.Keys: Early Keith Godchaux noted positively; described as barrel‑housing and contributing solid keyboards.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy Kreutzmann highlighted for a strong drum performance, better than most ’71 shows.
